sourceDescription: A user-approved AI-generated monochrome illustration developed from the supplied reference. Original authorship and publication were not independently verified.

approval.scope: The user requested a decal of the box and needle and approved the monochrome bitmap proposal.

/vector/decal/box-and-needle.svg.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 8, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.25, followed by SVG authoring root and provenance steps, uniform square normalization and the decal optimization profile.
/vector/decal/box-and-needle.svg.paint: Inherited from the caller. Internal details remain transparent cutouts.
/vector/decal/box-and-needle.svg.details: The box perspective, transparent cavity, broad panel details and separate needle remain together as one illustration. Advertising text and background are omitted.
